
- Scopes: `analytics:read`, `billing:read`, `cost`

|---|---|---|---|
| `$compare` | `?string` | no | previous_period (default): add comparison with the same number of days directly before. none: skip it |

## getCustomerServiceReport

Get Customer Service Report. `GET /reporting/customer-service`

Customer service report for a timeframe

Team-level figures only: volume (conversations opened / closed, messages received / sent, with a series per hour for one day or per day), messages by channel, first response and resolution times (average, median, 90th percentile), the backlog right now (same numbers and visibility as the dashboard), opened conversations by weekday and hour, conversations by tag (top 20), bot handover rate and team capacity right now. Any block may be null when it could not be computed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->reporting()->getCustomerServiceReport();
```

- Scopes: `analytics:read`

| `$from` | `?string` | no | First day, YYYY-MM-DD (custom only, inclusive) |
| `$to` | `?string` | no | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (custom only, inclusive). At most 366 days. |

Returns `CustomerServiceReport`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Reporting/get_customer_service_report_api_v1_reporting_customer_service_get)

## getMeta

Get Reporting Meta. `GET /reporting/meta`

What the caller may see in Reporting

Not plan-gated, so a client can show Reporting as locked when the plan lacks it (features.conversations false). can_view_agents = the caller holds reporting:read_agents and the workspace shows the Team tab. timezone is the workspace timezone used for day boundaries by default.

```php
$result = $sendseven->reporting()->getMeta();
```

- Scopes: `analytics:read`

Returns `ReportingMeta`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Reporting/get_reporting_meta_api_v1_reporting_meta_get)

## createReportSchedule

Create Report Schedule. `POST /reporting/schedules`

Create a scheduled report email

conversations. Signed-in people only (API keys and apps get 403 schedule_owner_required): the creator owns the schedule.

```php
$result = $sendseven->reporting()->createReportSchedule(name: 'name', reports: [], frequency: 'frequency', timeOfDay: 'time_of_day', recipientUserIds: []);
```

- Scopes: `reporting:schedule`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | 1 to 120 characters |
| `$reports` | `list<string>` | yes | One or more of customer_service, team, ai, marketing |
| `$frequency` | `string` | yes | daily \| weekly |
| `$timeOfDay` | `string` | yes | HH:MM in the workspace timezone |
| `$recipientUserIds` | `list<string>` | yes | Workspace user ids only (no external addresses), max 50 |
| `$weekday` | `?int` | no | 0 = Monday to 6 = Sunday; required for weekly |
| `$period` | `?string` | no | daily: previous_day (default). weekly: previous_7_days \| previous_week |
| `$includePdf` | `?bool` | no |  |
| `$status` | `?string` | no | active \| paused |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ScheduleOut`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Reporting/create_report_schedule_api_v1_reporting_schedules_post)
